remarks: Excellent FIRST HOME or INVESTOR special!!! Meticulous and lovingly maintained fully updated 1BR condo in the Shippan Neighborhood of Stamford. Beautiful updated sparkling kitchen cabinets and brand new countertops, stainless steel appliances, washer/dryer combo in the unit, great size bedroom with three closets including built-in closet shelves. Boiler is less than a year old. Roof is 1YR OLD. Windows in the living room have just been replaced. The entire unit was freshly painted and the storm doors are brand new as well. This lovely condo is on the 2nd floor of a well maintained building just steps to shopping and restaurants, walkable to beaches and Cummings and West Beach parks for the baseball, soccer, tennis and boating/beach enthusiasts. Minutes to Chelsea Piers, I-95, Downtown Stamford... 1 car dedicated CARPORT parking spot and additional parking on the street if desired. What does this amazing condo not have? Grab it while you can. The retaining wall is about to be repaired and the special assessment is paid in full by the seller.
